DIAGNOSIS READY: Cholesteatoma (or Granulation Tissue) in the post-tympanoplasty right ear.

The combination of shooting pain with eating (tensor tympani involvement) and pain upon wearing earrings (conductive interference from a mass) after recent surgery, despite improved hearing, strongly suggests a residual or recurrent cholesteatoma or granulation tissue rather than simple ossicular fixation.
